periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at an approximate 45-degree downward angle relative to the medial facial line, tapering toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High aspect ratio; the patch is an elongated teardrop shape with the vertical dimension significantly exceeding the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering where the vertical extent of the patch is concentrated below the geometric center of the eye.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Moderately deep U-shaped curvature on the posterior boundary of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band thickness, occupying approximately one-third of the visible torso length at the lateral margin.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Clear separation between the ears, with the gap width approximately 1.2 times the horizontal width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the superior margin of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced reddish-brown pelage discoloration/staining present on the ventral abdominal and pelvic regions.
